user.title: Voltello (VE-X)
user.description: Read-only access to the control state your Voltello plans apply (export limits, battery mode). Create an API key in the Voltello app: Menu, Manage Access, API Access. Village Energy support can tell you your customer id; the app does not show it.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless Village gave you another address.

reauth_confirm.title: New Voltello API key
reauth_confirm.description: VE-X refused the stored key. Enter a new one from the Voltello app.

error.invalid_auth: VE-X refused the key or customer id (401/403). Check both; Village may need to enable API read access on your account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach VE-X. Check the base URL and your connection.
error.no_service_points: This customer has no service points.
error.wrong_account: This key belongs to an account without this site.
error.invalid_url: Use an https:// address (the API key is sent with every request).

abort.already_configured: This Voltello site is already set up.
abort.invalid_auth: VE-X refused the key or customer id.
abort.no_inverter: No controllable inverter was found at this site.
abort.no_control_log: VE-X answered without a control log for this site. Village may need to enable API read access.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Optional. With a feed-in price sensor, polling slows to every 15 minutes while feed-in is above 2 c (nothing to curtail). With a PV power sensor, polling also runs when the sun entity is unavailable. The solar plan contract (e.g. Solar for Amber) makes Curtailment active count only its export limits; the list shows contracts seen in the control log. Leave empty to count any export limit.
